description: This Rust source file implements a generic file caching system with static fallback files, cache invalidation based on file modification times, and integration with an application state. It defines a Cached wrapper, a FileCache struct, and a trait for parsing files with application state context.

classes.name: Cached
classes.description: A thread-safe cache wrapper that stores content and last checked time, with methods for cache validation and refresh.

classes.name: FileCache
classes.description: A generic file cache that holds cached file contents with static fallback files, supporting asynchronous loading and cache invalidation.

methods.name: Cached::new
methods.description: Creates a new Cached instance with initial content and current check time.

methods.name: Cached::last_check_time
methods.description: Returns the last check time as a DateTime<Utc>.

methods.name: Cached::update_check_time
methods.description: Updates the last checked time to now.

methods.name: Cached::elapsed
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time in milliseconds since UNIX epoch divided by cache interval.

methods.name: Cached::needs_check
methods.description: Determines if the cache needs to be refreshed based on elapsed time.

methods.name: Cached::make_fresh
methods.description: Returns a new Cached instance with the same content but updated check time.

methods.name: FileCache::add_static
methods.description: Adds a static file to the cache as a fallback.

methods.name: FileCache::get
methods.description: Retrieves a file from cache or loads it from disk asynchronously.

methods.name: FileCache::get_static
methods.description: Retrieves a static file from the cache.

methods.name: FileCache::get_with_privilege
methods.description: Retrieves a file with privilege check, loading from cache or disk, with cache invalidation.
